安道全是建康府名医，号「神医」。宋江攻打大名府时患背疮，张顺想起他曾治好母亲的同.en:
An Daoquan was a renowned physician from Jiankang, known as the Divine Doctor. When Song Jiang developed a severe abscess on his back during the attack on Daming, Zhang Shun recalled that An had cured his mother of a similar illness and went alone to fetch him. An had agreed to leave, but Li Qiaonu tried to keep him there. That night Zhang Shun killed Li Qiaonu, her madam, and two servants, then wrote a bloody accusation naming An as the murderer to force him out of the city. Dai Zong met them on their return and used his supernatural speed to bring the doctor ahead to Liangshan, where Song Jiang gradually recovered under his care.

At the great assembly, An Daoquan was assigned the Earth Spirit Star and responsibility for treating illnesses and wounds. He accompanied the army after its amnesty and was still with it at Xiuzhou during the campaign against Fang La. There an imperial order recalled him to treat the ailing emperor. Song Jiang later lamented the absence of the physician when wounded comrades needed treatment. The novel ends with An serving as a senior physician in the Imperial Medical Office; it does not describe his death.
安道全是建康府名医，号「神医」。宋江攻打大名府时患背疮，张顺想起他曾治好母亲的同.ja:
安道全は建康府の名医で、「神医」と呼ばれた。大名府を攻めていた宋江が背中に重い腫れ物を患うと、張順は同じような病にかかった母を治してもらったことを思い出し、一人で迎えに向かった。安道全は出発を承諾していたが、李巧奴に引き留められる。その夜、張順は李巧奴と遣り手婆、二人の使用人を殺し、安道全を犯人とする血文字を書いて、彼を町から連れ出した。帰途には戴宗が迎えに来て、神行の術で医師を先に梁山泊へ送り届け、宋江は治療によって回復していった。

大聚義では地霊星に配され、軍中の病気や傷の治療を担当した。招安後も従軍し、方臘征討の際には秀州まで同行している。そこで皇帝の病を診るよう勅命を受け、都へ呼び戻された。宋江は後に、傷ついた仲間を十分に治療できず、この医師の不在を嘆いている。物語の末尾では太医院の金紫医官を務めており、死去の事情は記されていない。

白胜号「白日鼠」，住在黄泥冈以东的安乐村，曾受晁盖接济。智取生辰纲时，晁盖等人以.en:
Bai Sheng, nicknamed the Daylight Rat, lived in Anle Village east of Huangni Ridge and had received help from Chao Gai. During the birthday-gift robbery, Chao and his companions used Bai's home as their base. Bai posed as a wine seller while the seven men pretended to be jujube merchants. Together they tricked Yang Zhi and his escort into drinking drugged wine and carried off the gifts. He Qing later recognized the wine seller, and officials found stolen property at Bai's home. Under torture Bai named Chao Gai and, after further questioning, the other conspirators.

After Chao's party reached Liangshan, Wu Yong arranged to bribe the authorities and rescue Bai, who subsequently joined the stronghold. At the great assembly he was assigned the Earth Diminishing Star and became one of the infantry officers carrying confidential dispatches. He served in the campaigns following the amnesty, fell ill during the war against Fang La, and was ultimately listed among the heroes who died of illness in Hangzhou.
白胜号「白日鼠」，住在黄泥冈以东的安乐村，曾受晁盖接济。智取生辰纲时，晁盖等人以.ja:
白勝は「白日鼠」と呼ばれ、黄泥岡の東にある安楽村に住み、晁蓋から援助を受けたことがあった。生辰綱を奪う計画では、晁蓋たちが彼の家を足場にし、白勝は酒売りに扮した。棗商人を装う七人と示し合わせ、楊志と護送役たちに眠り薬入りの酒を飲ませて、生辰綱を奪う。後に何清が酒売りの正体に気づき、役人は白勝の家から盗品を発見した。白勝は拷問に屈して晁蓋の名を明かし、さらに追及されて他の仲間も供述した。

晁蓋たちが梁山泊へ入ると、呉用は役人に金を使って白勝を救う手配をし、白勝も後に山寨へ加わった。大聚義では地耗星に配され、軍中の機密文書を伝える歩軍頭領となる。招安後の征戦にも従ったが、方臘征討中に病み、杭州で病死した好漢の一人に数えられている。

鲍旭号「丧门神」，在寇州枯树山聚众，惯使阔剑。李逵私自下山后结识焦挺，两人前往枯.en:
Bao Xu, the Death God, commanded a band on Kushu Mountain in Kouzhou and fought with a broad sword. After leaving Liangshan without permission, Li Kui met Jiao Ting, and the two visited Bao Xu and quickly became close to him. Together they seized the prison carts carrying Xuan Zan and Hao Siwen, then led their men to help attack Lingzhou. This brought Bao into the Liangshan fellowship.

At the great assembly Bao Xu was assigned the Earth Violent Star and a post among the infantry officers. He often fought beside Li Kui and the shield-bearers Xiang Chong and Li Gun. During the attack on Hangzhou in the Fang La campaign, he pressed forward to the city gate. Song Jiang ordered a retreat, but Bao had already rushed inside. Shi Bao was waiting in ambush and killed him with a single stroke, while Xiang Chong and Li Gun protected Li Kui as he withdrew.
鲍旭号「丧门神」，在寇州枯树山聚众，惯使阔剑。李逵私自下山后结识焦挺，两人前往枯.ja:
鮑旭は「喪門神」と呼ばれ、寇州の枯樹山で一党を率い、幅広の剣を使った。梁山泊を勝手に下りた李逵は焦挺と知り合い、二人で枯樹山を訪れて鮑旭と意気投合する。三人は宣賛と郝思文を護送する囚人車を奪い、その後は兵を率いて凌州攻めに加わった。こうして鮑旭も梁山泊の仲間となった。

大聚義では地暴星に配され、歩軍将校となった。李逵や、盾を使う項充・李袞と組んで戦うことが多い。方臘征討の杭州攻めでは城門まで迫り、宋江が退却を命じた時には、すでに門内へ突入していた。そこに潜んでいた石宝に一刀で斬り殺され、項充と李袞は李逵を守って退いた。

蔡福是北京大名府的押牢节级，兼任刽子手，号「铁臂膊」；弟弟蔡庆也在狱中当差。卢俊.en:
Cai Fu was a prison superintendent and executioner in Daming, the Northern Capital, known as Iron Arms. His younger brother Cai Qing also worked in the prison. After Lu Junyi was imprisoned, Li Gu offered gold to have his master killed. Chai Jin then came with a warning and gold of his own to secure Lu's safety. After consulting Cai Qing, Cai Fu used his connections to prevent Lu's immediate execution and later also protected the imprisoned Shi Xiu.

When Liangshan attacked Daming, Cai Fu helped Chai Jin and Yue He enter the prison and subsequently took his family to Liangshan. He asked Chai to urge Wu Yong to stop the killing of civilians, though the novel states that nearly half the city had already suffered before the order arrived. At the great assembly he was assigned the Earth Level Star and shared responsibility for executions with Cai Qing. After the assault on Qingxi during the Fang La campaign, Cai Fu died of severe wounds despite treatment.
蔡福是北京大名府的押牢节级，兼任刽子手，号「铁臂膊」；弟弟蔡庆也在狱中当差。卢俊.ja:
蔡福は北京大名府の牢役人で、処刑人も兼ね、「鉄臂膊」と呼ばれた。弟の蔡慶も牢で働いていた。盧俊義が投獄されると、李固は主人を殺させようと黄金を持ちかけ、続いて柴進が警告と金を携えて、盧俊義を守るよう求めに来る。蔡福は蔡慶と相談し、関係者に働きかけて盧俊義がすぐ殺されるのを防ぎ、後には捕らわれた石秀も世話した。

梁山軍が大名府を攻めた際には柴進と楽和を牢内へ導き、その後は家族とともに梁山泊へ入った。蔡福は民衆を殺さないよう呉用に伝えてほしいと柴進に頼んだが、原著は命令が届く頃には町の半ば近くが被害を受けていたとも記す。大聚義では地平星に配され、蔡慶とともに処刑を担当した。方臘征討で清渓を攻めた後、重傷が治らず亡くなった。

蔡庆是北京大名府的小押狱，蔡福的弟弟。因爱在鬓边戴一枝花，人称「一枝花」。卢俊义.en:
Cai Qing was a junior jailer in Daming, the Northern Capital, and Cai Fu's younger brother. His habit of wearing a flower by his temple earned him the name Single Blossom. When Lu Junyi was unjustly imprisoned, Cai Qing discussed how to protect him with his brother and helped care for both Lu and Shi Xiu in prison. After Liangshan captured Daming, the brothers took their families to the stronghold.

At the great assembly Cai Qing was assigned the Earth Loss Star and shared execution duties with Cai Fu. In the Fang La campaign, Cai Fu died of wounds after the fighting at Qingxi, while Cai Qing carried out Song Jiang's order to execute Du Wei as an offering to the slain officers. After the army returned and received its rewards, he followed Guan Sheng back to Daming and became a commoner again. The novel gives no further account of his lifespan or death.
蔡庆是北京大名府的小押狱，蔡福的弟弟。因爱在鬓边戴一枝花，人称「一枝花」。卢俊义.ja:
蔡慶は北京大名府の下級牢役人で、蔡福の弟である。鬢に一輪の花を挿すのを好み、「一枝花」と呼ばれた。盧俊義が冤罪で投獄されると、兄と相談して保護を図り、牢内で盧俊義と石秀を世話した。梁山軍が大名府を落とした後、兄弟は家族を連れて山寨へ入る。

大聚義では地損星に配され、蔡福とともに処刑を担当した。方臘征討の清渓での戦いの後、蔡福は重傷のため亡くなり、蔡慶は宋江の命で杜微を処刑して、殺された将士への供えとした。帰還して恩賞を受けると、関勝に従って北京大名府へ戻り、平民となった。その後の寿命や死去の事情は原著に記されていない。

曹正是开封府人，世代屠户出身，做得一手宰牲剔骨的本事，号「操刀鬼」，曾拜林冲为师.en:
Cao Zheng came from a family of butchers in Kaifeng. His skill in slaughtering and cutting meat earned him the name Knife-Wielding Demon, and he had studied martial arts under Lin Chong. After losing the capital entrusted to him for a trading journey to Shandong, he married into a local farming family and ran an inn. He fought Yang Zhi after the loss of the birthday gifts, and they became acquainted when they exchanged names. Cao later devised a plan to take Lu Zhishen up Twin Dragons Mountain as a false prisoner, tricking the guards into opening their defenses and helping Lu and Yang seize the stronghold.

After the three mountain bands joined forces against Qingzhou, Cao followed the Twin Dragons group to Liangshan. At the great assembly he was put in charge of slaughtering livestock. He served in the campaigns following the amnesty. During the attack on Xuanzhou in the Fang La campaign, he and Wang Dingliu were struck by poisoned arrows fired from the walls and died after returning to camp.
曹正是开封府人，世代屠户出身，做得一手宰牲剔骨的本事，号「操刀鬼」，曾拜林冲为师.ja:
曹正は開封府の代々続く屠畜業の家に生まれ、家畜をさばく腕前から「操刀鬼」と呼ばれた。武芸は林沖に学んでいる。富豪から託された資金を山東での商いで失い、地元の農家に婿入りして酒店を営んでいた。生辰綱を奪われた楊志と戦った後、名を明かし合って知り合う。さらに魯智深を捕虜に見せかけて二竜山へ連行する策を立て、関門を開かせて、魯智深と楊志の山寨奪取を助けた。

三山の一党が力を合わせて青州を攻めた後、曹正も二竜山の仲間とともに梁山泊へ入った。大聚義では牛馬や豚、羊などの屠畜を担当した。招安後も従軍したが、方臘征討の宣州攻めで王定六とともに城壁からの毒矢を受け、陣へ戻って亡くなった。

柴进号「小旋风」，是沧州横海郡的富豪，原著称其为柴世宗后裔，家有誓书铁券。他广交.en:
Chai Jin, the Little Whirlwind, was a wealthy man of Henghai Commandery in Cangzhou. The novel identifies him as a descendant of Emperor Chai Shizong, whose family possessed an imperial charter of protection. He welcomed men from the martial world and supported Lin Chong, Song Jiang, and Wu Song. He also recommended Lin Chong to Liangshan.

Chai went to Gaotangzhou when his uncle Chai Huangcheng was oppressed by Yin Tianxi. After Li Kui killed Yin, Gao Lian imprisoned Chai Jin. The jailer Lin Ren tried to save him by reporting him dead and hiding him in a dry well. When Liangshan captured the city, Li Kui descended into the well and rescued him. Chai joined the stronghold and later shared responsibility for its finances and provisions with Li Ying.

During the Fang La campaign, Chai infiltrated enemy territory with Yan Qing, took the name Ke Yin, and became Fang La's son-in-law. He turned against Fang's forces during the final attack on Bangyuan Cave. After the campaign he received command at Cangzhou, but saw Dai Zong resign and Ruan Xiaoqi lose his office. Fearing punishment for having been Fang La's son-in-law, he pleaded illness, resigned, and returned home as a commoner. He later died without preceding illness.
柴进号「小旋风」，是沧州横海郡的富豪，原著称其为柴世宗后裔，家有誓书铁券。他广交.ja:
柴進は「小旋風」と呼ばれる滄州横海郡の富豪で、原著では柴世宗の子孫とされ、家に誓書鉄券を持っている。広く豪傑を迎え、林沖、宋江、武松らを援助し、林沖が梁山泊へ入る際にも紹介状を与えた。

高唐州の叔父柴皇城が殷天錫に苦しめられると、見舞いに向かった。李逵が殷天錫を殺したため、高廉によって投獄される。牢役人の藺仁は柴進を救おうと、死んだと偽って枯れ井戸に隠した。梁山軍が高唐州を落とすと、李逵が井戸へ下りて救い出し、柴進も山寨に加わる。後に李応とともに財貨と兵糧を管理した。

方臘征討では燕青と敵地へ潜入し、柯引と名乗って方臘の娘婿となり、幇源洞への最後の攻撃で寝返って味方を助けた。帰還後は滄州の軍職を授けられたが、戴宗の辞官や阮小七の免官を知り、自分も方臘の娘婿だったことで罪を問われるのを恐れた。病を理由に辞職し、故郷で平民として暮らした後、病気の兆しもなく亡くなった。

陈达是邺城人，号「跳涧虎」，使点钢枪，与朱武、杨春在少华山聚众。为取华阴县钱粮，.en:
Chen Da, the Gorge-Leaping Tiger, came from Yecheng and wielded a steel spear. He led a band on Shaohua Mountain with Zhu Wu and Yang Chun. Seeking provisions from Huayin County, he ignored his companions' warnings and tried to force his way through the Shi estate, where Shi Jin captured him. Zhu Wu and Yang Chun offered to die with him, prompting Shi Jin to release Chen and befriend all three.

Shi Jin was later imprisoned after trying to help the painter Wang Yi and his daughter, who had been abused by Prefect He. Liangshan's men captured Huazhou and rescued both Shi Jin and Lu Zhishen. Chen Da then joined Liangshan with his Shaohua companions and was appointed a cavalry officer with long-range scouting duties at the great assembly.

During the Fang La campaign, Chen accompanied Shi Jin, Shi Xiu, and three other officers on a reconnaissance mission to Yuling Pass. Pang Wanchun, Lei Jiong, and Ji Ji ambushed them with bows and crossbows, killing all six. Zhu Wu mourned Chen Da and Yang Chun when he heard the news.
陈达是邺城人，号「跳涧虎」，使点钢枪，与朱武、杨春在少华山聚众。为取华阴县钱粮，.ja:
陳達は鄴城の出身で、「跳澗虎」と呼ばれ、鋼槍を使った。朱武、楊春とともに少華山で一党を率いる。華陰県の兵糧を奪おうとして仲間の忠告を聞かず、史家荘を押し通ろうとしたところ、史進に捕らえられた。朱武と楊春がともに死ぬ覚悟を示したため、史進は陳達を放し、三人と親交を結んだ。

後に史進は賀太守に苦しめられた絵師の王義とその娘を救おうとして投獄される。梁山の一行が華州を攻め、史進と魯智深を救出すると、陳達も少華山の仲間とともに梁山泊へ入った。大聚義では、遠方の偵察も担う馬軍小彪将に任じられた。

方臘征討では、史進、石秀らと計六将で昱嶺関を偵察し、龐万春、雷炯、計稷の弓と弩による伏兵に遭って全員が射殺された。朱武は報せを受けて、陳達と楊春のために涙を流した。

戴宗原是江州两院押牢节级，号「神行太保」。他的神行法需把甲马缚在腿上，两枚可日行.en:
Dai Zong was a prison superintendent in Jiangzhou, known as the Marvelous Traveler. His supernatural method required paper talismans tied to his legs: two let him travel five hundred li a day, and four eight hundred. After being exiled to Jiangzhou, Song Jiang befriended him through a letter from Wu Yong and met Li Kui through him.

When Song Jiang was imprisoned for writing seditious verses, Prefect Cai Jiu sent Dai to the capital with a letter. Passing Liangshan, he was detained there and joined a plan to rescue Song. Wu Yong had Xiao Rang and Jin Dajian forge a reply from Cai Jing. Dai carried it back to Jiangzhou, but Huang Wenbing spotted inconsistencies in its seal, and Dai too was imprisoned. Chao Gai and his companions raided the execution ground, rescued both men, and later brought them into Liangshan.

At the great assembly Dai became chief of intelligence, repeatedly carrying dispatches and fetching urgent assistance. After the Fang La campaign he received a command at Yanzhou but surrendered his commission and retired to the temple of Mount Tai in Tai'anzhou. Several months later he bade the community farewell and died laughing. The novel adds that an image was made around his preserved body and that he subsequently manifested there.
戴宗原是江州两院押牢节级，号「神行太保」。他的神行法需把甲马缚在腿上，两枚可日行.ja:
戴宗は江州の牢役人で、「神行太保」と呼ばれた。神行の術では甲馬という札を脚に結び、二枚なら一日に五百里、四枚なら八百里を進む。江州へ流された宋江は呉用の手紙を通して戴宗と親しくなり、さらに戴宗の紹介で李逵と知り合った。

宋江が反逆の詩を書いた罪で投獄されると、戴宗は蔡九知府の命で都へ手紙を運ぶ。途中の梁山泊で引き留められ、救出の相談に加わった。呉用は蕭譲と金大堅に蔡京の返書を偽造させるが、戴宗が江州へ持ち帰ると、黄文炳が印章の不審な点を見抜き、戴宗も捕らわれた。晁蓋たちの刑場襲撃によって二人は救われ、後に梁山泊へ加わった。

大聚義では情報収集を統括する頭領となり、伝令や緊急の救援依頼に奔走した。方臘征討後に兗州府都統制を授けられたものの辞官し、泰安州の岳廟で暮らす。数か月後、人々に別れを告げて大笑いしながら亡くなった。原著には、その遺体をもとに像が作られ、後にたびたび霊験を示したとも記されている。

邓飞是襄阳府人，号「火眼狻猊」，两眼红赤，能使铁链。他与孟康占据饮马川，又救下被.en:
Deng Fei came from Xiangyang Prefecture and was known as the Fiery-Eyed Lion for his red eyes. He fought with an iron chain. He and Meng Kang seized Yinmachuan, later rescued Pei Xuan on his way into exile on Shamen Island, and made the older Pei their leader.

While searching for Gongsun Sheng, Dai Zong passed Yinmachuan with Yang Lin, who recognized his old acquaintance Deng Fei. Dai told the three leaders about Liangshan and arranged to take them there on his return. At the great assembly Deng became a cavalry officer assigned to long-range reconnaissance.

During the assault on Hangzhou's northern gate in the Fang La campaign, Suo Chao pursued Shi Bao and was knocked from his horse by a meteor hammer. Deng rushed to save him, but Shi Bao rode up before he could defend himself and killed him with a single stroke.
邓飞是襄阳府人，号「火眼狻猊」，两眼红赤，能使铁链。他与孟康占据饮马川，又救下被.ja:
鄧飛は襄陽府の出身で、赤い両眼から「火眼狻猊」と呼ばれ、鉄の鎖を武器とした。孟康とともに飲馬川を占拠し、その後、沙門島へ流刑となる途中の裴宣を救い、年長の裴宣を首領に推した。

公孫勝を捜す戴宗が楊林とともに飲馬川を通ると、楊林は旧知の鄧飛に気づいた。戴宗は三人の頭領に梁山泊のことを話し、帰途に一緒に向かう約束をする。大聚義では、遠方の偵察を兼ねる馬軍小彪将に任じられた。

方臘征討で杭州の北関門を攻めた際、索超が石宝を追って流星鎚を受け、落馬した。鄧飛は急いで救いに出たが、石宝が馬を寄せるのに対処できず、一刀で斬り殺された。

丁得孙号「中箭虎」，原为东昌府张清手下副将，面颊连颈项都有疤痕，擅长在马上掷飞叉.en:
Ding Desun, the Arrow-Struck Tiger, was one of Zhang Qing's lieutenants at Dongchang. He had scars across his cheeks and neck and specialized in throwing forks from horseback. When Liangshan attacked Dongchang, he wounded Xiang Chong with a thrown fork and helped Gong Wang support Zhang Qing in battle.

Liangshan captured the two lieutenants before trapping Zhang Qing, and all three submitted. At the great assembly Ding became an infantry officer.

Late in the Fang La campaign, Lu Junyi's army ambushed the troops led by Pang Wanchun and his companions as they raided the camp. At the dawn muster, it was reported that a venomous snake had bitten Ding Desun's foot in the grass beside a mountain path. The poison spread into his body and killed him.
丁得孙号「中箭虎」，原为东昌府张清手下副将，面颊连颈项都有疤痕，擅长在马上掷飞叉.ja:
丁得孫は「中箭虎」と呼ばれ、東昌府の張清に仕える副将だった。頬から首にかけて傷痕があり、馬上から飛叉を投げるのを得意とした。梁山軍の東昌攻めでは飛叉で項充を傷つけ、龔旺とともに張清の戦いを助けた。

二人の副将は張清より先に梁山軍に捕らえられ、後に張清も計略によって捕まると、三人そろって降った。大聚義では丁得孫は歩軍将校となる。

方臘征討の終盤、盧俊義の軍は山道に伏兵を置き、夜襲に来た龐万春らの兵を破った。夜明けの点呼で、丁得孫は山道の草むらで毒蛇に足をかまれ、毒が体内に回って亡くなったと判明した。

董平号「双枪将」，原是东平府兵马都监，善使双枪，也通晓音乐。他曾向程万里求娶其女.en:
Dong Ping, the General of Two Spears, commanded troops in Dongping Prefecture. He wielded paired spears and was also accomplished in music. He had sought permission to marry Prefect Cheng Wanli's daughter without success. When Liangshan sent envoys to demand provisions, Dong proposed killing them, but Cheng ordered them beaten and sent back.

During the attack on Dongping, Song Jiang trapped Dong in an ambush and personally untied him. After surrendering, Dong offered to trick the defenders into opening the gates. He led Liangshan's army into the city, killed Cheng's household, and seized his daughter. At the great assembly he became one of the Five Tiger Generals of the cavalry.

At Dusong Pass during the Fang La campaign, a cannon blast injured Dong's left arm. He later went on foot with Zhang Qing to attack the pass without informing Lu Junyi. His injured arm prevented him from using his spear properly, forcing him back. When Li Tianrun stabbed Zhang Qing, Dong rushed to help and was killed from behind by Zhang Tao. Their bodies, together with Zhou Tong's, were later buried at the pass.
董平号「双枪将」，原是东平府兵马都监，善使双枪，也通晓音乐。他曾向程万里求娶其女.ja:
董平は「双槍将」と呼ばれる東平府の兵馬都監で、二本の槍を使い、音楽にも通じていた。程万里の娘との結婚を求めていたが、許されていない。梁山泊が兵糧を求めて使者を送ると、董平は殺すよう主張したが、程万里は杖で打って送り返させた。

宋江は東平府を攻めて伏兵で董平を捕らえ、自ら縄を解いて遇した。降った董平は城門を開かせる役を申し出て梁山軍を導き入れ、程万里の一家を殺して、その娘を奪った。大聚義では馬軍五虎将の一人となった。

方臘征討の独松関攻めでは、砲の爆風で左腕を負傷した。その後、盧俊義に知らせず張清と徒歩で関を攻めたが、傷ついた腕では槍をうまく使えず退く。張清が厲天閏に突き倒されると救援に向かい、背後から張韜に斬り殺された。二人の遺体は周通の遺体とともに、後に関で埋葬された。

杜迁号「摸着天」，是梁山泊早期头领。林冲初到时，山寨由王伦、杜迁、宋万三人主持，.en:
Du Qian, known as Touching the Sky, was one of Liangshan's earliest leaders. When Lin Chong first arrived, Wang Lun, Du Qian, and Song Wan ran the stronghold, while Zhu Gui received travelers at the inn below the mountain.

When Wang Lun tried to turn Lin Chong away, Du Qian openly argued that Chai Jin had helped the stronghold and that they should not reject someone he recommended. After Lin Chong killed Wang Lun, Du, Song Wan, and Zhu Gui accepted the new leadership and remained at Liangshan. He served under Chao Gai and then Song Jiang, becoming one of the hundred and eight heroes and an infantry officer at the great assembly.

Du Qian continued to campaign with the army after the amnesty. During the fighting at Qingxi against Fang La, he and Zou Yuan were trampled to death by cavalry and were recorded among the campaign's fallen officers.
杜迁号「摸着天」，是梁山泊早期头领。林冲初到时，山寨由王伦、杜迁、宋万三人主持，.ja:
杜遷は「摸着天」と呼ばれ、梁山泊の初期からの頭領だった。林沖が初めて訪れた頃は、王倫、杜遷、宋万の三人が山寨を取り仕切り、朱貴が山麓の酒店で人々を迎えていた。

王倫が林沖を追い返そうとすると、杜遷は柴進から受けた恩を挙げ、その紹介した人物を拒むべきではないと面と向かって諫めた。後に林沖が王倫を殺すと、宋万、朱貴とともに新たな首領に従って山寨に残る。晁蓋、宋江が相次いで主となる中で百八人の一人となり、大聚義では歩軍将校に任じられた。

招安後も従軍を続けた。方臘軍と清渓で戦った際、鄒淵とともに騎兵に踏み殺され、征討で戦死した将士の名簿に載っている。

杜兴是中山府人，因面貌粗莽，号「鬼脸儿」。他在蓟州经商时打死同伙，入狱后蒙杨雄维.en:
Du Xing came from Zhongshan and was nicknamed Demon Face because of his rough appearance. While trading in Jizhou, he killed a business companion and was imprisoned. Yang Xiong helped secure his release. He later became Li Ying's trusted steward at the estate on Dulong Ridge.

After the Zhu family captured Shi Qian, Du reunited with Yang Xiong and introduced him and Shi Xiu to Li Ying. Du carried Li's second, personally written appeal for Shi Qian's release, but it was rejected. After defeating the Zhu estate, Liangshan's men disguised themselves as officials to arrest Li Ying and Du Xing, then staged a rescue on the road. They brought away the families and property and burned the estate, leaving the two men to join Liangshan.

At the great assembly Du was assigned to the southern inn with Zhu Gui, gathering information and receiving visitors. After the Fang La campaign he returned home with Li Ying. They lived together as wealthy men, and the novel explicitly says that both met peaceful ends.
杜兴是中山府人，因面貌粗莽，号「鬼脸儿」。他在蓟州经商时打死同伙，入狱后蒙杨雄维.ja:
杜興は中山府の出身で、いかつい顔つきから「鬼臉児」と呼ばれた。薊州で商いをしていた時に仲間の商人を殺して投獄されたが、楊雄の助力で救われる。その後は独竜岡の李応の荘園で、信頼される管理人となった。

祝家荘に時遷が捕まると、杜興は楊雄と再会し、彼と石秀を李応に紹介した。李応が自筆で書いた二度目の釈放願いを届けたが、拒絶される。祝家荘を破った梁山の一行は、役人に扮して李応と杜興を逮捕し、道中で救う芝居を打った。家族と財産も運び去って荘園を焼き、二人を梁山泊へ加えた。

大聚義では朱貴とともに南山の酒店を担当し、情報収集と来客の接待に当たった。方臘征討後は李応と故郷へ戻り、ともに富豪として暮らす。原著は二人とも穏やかな最期を迎えたと明記している。

段景住是涿州人，号「金毛犬」，在北地以盗马为生。他盗得大金王子的照夜玉狮子马，想.en:
Duan Jingzhu, the Golden-Haired Hound, came from Zhuozhou and lived by stealing horses in the north. He stole the Night-Shining Jade Lion, a horse belonging to a Jin prince, intending to offer it to Song Jiang as his introduction to Liangshan. Men at Zengtou Market seized the horse, so he went to report the loss. The incident helped trigger Liangshan's first attack on Zengtou, during which Chao Gai was fatally wounded by an arrow.

Duan later bought horses in the north with Yang Lin and Shi Yong. Yu Baosi seized more than two hundred of them and delivered them to Zengtou, prompting another expedition. At the great assembly Duan became one of the infantry officers carrying confidential dispatches.

During the Fang La campaign, Duan and Hou Jian accompanied Zhang Heng and Ruan Xiaoqi to find boats on the coast, hoping to enter the Qiantang River by way of Haiyan. The wind drove them out to sea and wrecked their boats as they tried to return. Unable to swim, Duan and Hou both drowned.
段景住是涿州人，号「金毛犬」，在北地以盗马为生。他盗得大金王子的照夜玉狮子马，想.ja:
段景住は涿州の出身で、「金毛犬」と呼ばれ、北方で馬を盗んで生計を立てていた。金の王子の愛馬、照夜玉獅子を盗み、梁山泊へ身を寄せる手土産として宋江に贈ろうとしたが、曾頭市で奪われ、報告に向かった。この事件が梁山軍の最初の曾頭市攻めにつながり、その戦いで晁蓋は矢を受けて亡くなった。

後には楊林、石勇と北方で馬を買い付けたが、二百頭余りを郁保四に奪われ、曾頭市へ送られてしまう。これが再度の征討を引き起こした。大聚義では軍中の機密を伝える歩軍頭領の一人となった。

方臘征討では侯健とともに張横、阮小七に従って海辺で船を集め、海塩から銭塘江へ入ろうとした。ところが風で沖へ流され、戻ろうとした際にも船が壊れる。泳げなかった段景住と侯健はともに溺死した。

樊瑞是濮州人，幼年做过全真先生，号「混世魔王」，会使流星锤和法术。他与项充、李衮.en:
Fan Rui came from Puzhou and had been a Daoist practitioner from an early age. Known as the Demon King of Chaos, he used a meteor hammer and magical arts. He led a band on Mangdang Mountain with Xiang Chong and Li Gun and threatened to swallow up Liangshan.

Gongsun Sheng arranged a battle formation and used magic to defeat Fan's supernatural wind, driving Xiang Chong and Li Gun into a pit where they were captured. Song Jiang released them. They returned to persuade Fan, who promptly surrendered with his men and became Gongsun Sheng's disciple. At the great assembly he was appointed an infantry officer and later continued to serve on campaign.

Fan Rui survived the war against Fang La. After the army returned and received its rewards, Zhu Wu studied Daoist arts under him. The two became Daoist practitioners, traveled the country, and went to join Gongsun Sheng in religious life. The novel records that they lived out their remaining years in this way.
樊瑞是濮州人，幼年做过全真先生，号「混世魔王」，会使流星锤和法术。他与项充、李衮.ja:
樊瑞は濮州の出身で、幼い頃から全真の道士となり、「混世魔王」と呼ばれた。流星鎚と法術を使い、項充、李袞とともに芒碭山で一党を率い、梁山泊を併呑すると豪語した。

公孫勝は陣を布いて術を使い、樊瑞の妖風を破り、項充と李袞を落とし穴へ追い込んで捕らえた。宋江に放された二人が山へ戻って説くと、樊瑞はすぐ仲間を連れて降り、公孫勝の弟子となった。大聚義では歩軍将校に任じられ、その後も従軍した。

方臘との戦いを生き延び、帰還して恩賞を受けた後、朱武に道術を教えた。二人は全真の道士となって各地を旅し、公孫勝を頼って出家する。原著は、そのようにして残る生涯を送ったと記している。

龚旺号「花项虎」，浑身刺有虎斑，颈项刺着虎头，擅长马上飞枪。他原是东昌府张清手下.en:
Gong Wang, the Flowery-Necked Tiger, had tiger stripes tattooed across his body and a tiger's head on his neck. He specialized in throwing spears from horseback. He was originally a lieutenant under Zhang Qing at Dongchang, fighting alongside Ding Desun.

During Liangshan's attack on Dongchang, Lin Chong and Hua Rong cut him off. His thrown spear missed, leaving him without a weapon, and the two captured him alive. Zhang Qing was subsequently captured as well, and all three joined Liangshan. At the great assembly Gong became an infantry officer.

During the attack on Deqing County in the Fang La campaign, Gong fought Huang Ai and pursued him across a stream. Both rider and horse became trapped in the water, and enemy soldiers killed him with their spears. Huyan Zhuo reported his death to Song Jiang after the armies reunited at Hangzhou.
龚旺号「花项虎」，浑身刺有虎斑，颈项刺着虎头，擅长马上飞枪。他原是东昌府张清手下.ja:
龔旺は「花項虎」と呼ばれ、全身に虎の縞、首に虎の頭の刺青を入れていた。馬上から槍を投げるのを得意とし、もとは東昌府の張清に仕える副将で、丁得孫とともに戦っていた。

梁山軍の東昌攻めでは林沖と花栄に行く手を阻まれる。投げた槍が相手に当たらず、武器を失って二人に生け捕られた。張清も後に捕まると、三人とも梁山泊へ加わる。大聚義では歩軍将校に任じられた。

方臘征討の徳清県攻めで黄愛と戦い、追って小川を渡る際、人馬とも川にはまり、南軍の槍で突き殺された。呼延灼は杭州で本隊と合流した後、宋江にその死を報告した。

公孙胜是蓟州道士，道号一清，号「入云龙」，能呼风唤雨。他前往东溪村寻晁盖，共谋生.en:
Gongsun Sheng was a Daoist from Jizhou, with the religious name Yiqing and the nickname Dragon in the Clouds. He could summon wind and rain. He visited Chao Gai in Dongxi Village to plan the birthday-gift robbery. The seven conspirators were Gongsun, Chao Gai, Wu Yong, Liu Tang, and the three Ruan brothers, with Bai Sheng assisting as the wine seller. After the crime was discovered, they went to Liangshan.

He later returned home to visit his mother. When Gao Lian's magic blocked Liangshan's attack on Gaotangzhou, Dai Zong and Li Kui went to fetch him. His teacher Luo permitted him to leave, and Gongsun helped defeat Gao's spells and capture the city. He subsequently overcame Fan Rui at Mangdang Mountain and took him as a disciple. At the great assembly he shared responsibility for military strategy and confidential affairs with Wu Yong.

In the 120-chapter edition, Gongsun Sheng served not only in the Liao campaign after the amnesty but also in the wars against Tian Hu and Wang Qing. After Wang Qing's defeat and the army's return to the capital, he followed his teacher's earlier instructions and took leave of his companions. He returned to study with Luo and care for his mother, taking no part in the later war against Fang La.
公孙胜是蓟州道士，道号一清，号「入云龙」，能呼风唤雨。他前往东溪村寻晁盖，共谋生.ja:
公孫勝は薊州の道士で、道号を一清といい、「入雲竜」と呼ばれ、風雨を起こす術を使った。東渓村の晁蓋を訪ねて生辰綱の強奪を企てる。計画の七人は公孫勝、晁蓋、呉用、劉唐、阮氏三兄弟で、白勝が別に酒売り役を務めた。事件が露見すると、ともに梁山泊へ入った。

一度は母を見舞うため帰郷したが、梁山軍が高唐州で高廉の法術に阻まれると、戴宗と李逵が迎えに来る。師の羅真人から下山を許され、公孫勝は敵の術を破って城の攻略を助けた。後には芒碭山で樊瑞を降し、弟子に迎える。大聚義では呉用とともに機密を扱う軍師となった。

百二十回本では、招安後に遼だけでなく田虎、王慶の征討にも参加している。王慶を平定して都へ帰還した後、羅真人の以前の教えに従って仲間に別れを告げた。師のもとで道を学び、母を養うため山へ戻り、続く方臘征討には加わらなかった。

顾大嫂号「母大虫」，与丈夫孙新在登州城外经营酒店，也卖肉、开赌。解珍、解宝是她的.en:
Gu Dasao, the Tigress, ran an inn outside Dengzhou with her husband Sun Xin, also selling meat and operating gambling tables. When her cousins Xie Zhen and Xie Bao were falsely imprisoned after a dispute over a hunted tiger, Yue He brought the news, and she immediately discussed a rescue with Sun Xin.

Sun Xin proposed breaking them out and planned a refuge afterward, recruiting Zou Yuan and Zou Run. The couple then summoned Sun Li by claiming that Gu was gravely ill and persuaded him to take part. After rescuing the brothers, the group joined the attack on the Zhu estate on their way to Liangshan. They used Sun Li's connection with Luan Tingyu to enter the estate and attack from within.

At the great assembly Gu and Sun Xin were assigned to the eastern inn. During the Fang La campaign, they disguised themselves as refugees and found a mountain path around Dusong Pass, helping the army capture it. After the campaign she received the title Lady of Dongyuan County and returned to service in Dengzhou with Sun Li, Sun Xin, and their families.
顾大嫂号「母大虫」，与丈夫孙新在登州城外经营酒店，也卖肉、开赌。解珍、解宝是她的.ja:
顧大嫂は「母大虫」と呼ばれ、夫の孫新と登州の城外で酒店を営み、肉の販売や賭場も手がけていた。従弟の解珍と解宝が虎狩りをめぐって毛太公に陥れられ、投獄されると、楽和から報せを受けてすぐ孫新と救出を相談した。

孫新が牢破りとその後の行き先を考え、鄒淵、鄒潤に協力を求める。夫妻は顧大嫂が重病だと偽って孫立を呼び寄せ、彼にも参加を迫った。兄弟を救い出した一行は、梁山泊へ向かう途中で祝家荘の戦いに加わり、孫立と欒廷玉の縁を利用して荘内へ入り、内外から攻撃した。

大聚義では孫新とともに東山の酒店を担当した。方臘征討の独松関攻めでは、夫妻で避難民を装い、山中の抜け道を探して攻略を助ける。帰還後は東源県君に封じられ、孫立、孫新と家族たちとともに登州で再び用いられた。

关胜号「大刀」，原任蒲东巡检，原著称其为关羽后裔，善使青龙偃月刀。梁山围攻大名府.en:
Guan Sheng, the Great Blade, was originally a patrol inspector at Pudong. The novel identifies him as a descendant of Guan Yu and a master of the Green Dragon crescent blade. When Liangshan besieged Daming, Xuan Zan recommended him to Cai Jing. Guan led an army with Hao Siwen and Xuan Zan directly against Liangshan, forcing Song Jiang to return to defend it.

Guan fought Lin Chong and Qin Ming simultaneously and was beginning to struggle when Song Jiang called off the engagement. Huyan Zhuo then pretended to surrender and lured Guan into an ambush during a night raid. Song Jiang personally freed and courteously received his captive, who submitted with his two companions. At the great assembly Guan headed the list of the Five Tiger Generals and continued to campaign with the army.

He survived the Fang La campaign and was appointed commander of troops in Daming. He won the confidence of his soldiers, but one day, returning from a drill, he fell from his horse while drunk, became ill, and died.
关胜号「大刀」，原任蒲东巡检，原著称其为关羽后裔，善使青龙偃月刀。梁山围攻大名府.ja:
関勝は「大刀」と呼ばれ、もとは蒲東の巡検だった。原著では関羽の子孫とされ、青竜偃月刀を使う。梁山軍が大名府を囲むと、宣賛が蔡京に関勝を推薦した。関勝は郝思文、宣賛とともに梁山泊を直接攻め、宋江を救援に引き返させた。

林沖、秦明の二人を同時に相手にして苦しくなりかけたところで、宋江が戦いを打ち切る。その後、偽って降った呼延灼に誘われて夜襲に向かい、伏兵に捕らえられた。宋江に縄を解かれ丁重に迎えられると、二人の仲間とともに降った。大聚義では馬軍五虎将の筆頭に挙げられ、引き続き従軍した。

方臘征討を生き延び、大名府正兵馬総管となって兵士たちの信頼を得た。しかしある日、訓練から戻る途中、酔って足を踏み外して落馬し、病を得て亡くなった。

郭盛号「赛仁贵」，是西川嘉陵人，曾向本地张提辖学方天戟。他贩卖水银时在黄河遭风翻.en:
Guo Sheng, the Rival of Rengui, came from Jialing in western Sichuan and learned the halberd from the local officer Zhang. While trading mercury, he lost his boat to a storm on the Yellow River and could not return home. Hearing that Lu Fang of Duiying Mountain was a skilled halberd fighter, he went to challenge him.

They fought for more than ten days without a decisive result. When Song Jiang and Hua Rong's party passed, the ornamental cords on their halberds had become tangled. Hua Rong shot through the cords with one arrow, separating the weapons and ending the contest. Guo and Lu agreed to join the others at Liangshan and later served together as cavalry guards of the central command.

During the assault on Wulong Ridge in the Fang La campaign, Guo and Lu rushed ahead to seize the heights. Before Guo reached the ridge, a large rock hurled from above killed both him and his horse. Lu Fang subsequently died in a fall while grappling with Bai Qin on the ridge.
郭盛号「赛仁贵」，是西川嘉陵人，曾向本地张提辖学方天戟。他贩卖水银时在黄河遭风翻.ja:
郭盛は「賽仁貴」と呼ばれる西川嘉陵の出身で、地元の張提轄に方天戟を学んだ。水銀を売り歩く途中、黄河で嵐に遭って船を失い、帰郷できなくなる。対影山の呂方が戟の名手と聞き、腕を比べに向かった。

十日余り戦っても勝負がつかず、宋江と花栄の一行が通りかかった時には、二本の戟の飾り紐が絡み合っていた。花栄が一矢で紐を断ち、二人の争いを止める。郭盛と呂方は一行と梁山泊へ向かうことに同意し、後にはともに中軍を守る馬軍の将となった。

方臘征討の烏竜嶺攻めでは、呂方と先を争って山へ向かったが、嶺に着く前に上から飛んできた大石に打たれ、人馬ともに死んだ。呂方もその後、嶺上で白欽と組み合い、転落して亡くなった。

韩滔是东京人，武举出身，任陈州团练使，号「百胜将」，使枣木槊。他被呼延灼举荐为征.en:
Han Tao came from the Eastern Capital, had passed the military examinations, and served as a training commissioner in Chenzhou. Known as the General of a Hundred Victories, he wielded a jujube-wood lance. Huyan Zhuo recommended him as chief vanguard commander for the expedition against Liangshan, with Peng Qi as his deputy.

After Liangshan's hooked-lance troops broke the linked cavalry, Liu Tang and Du Qian captured Han. Song Jiang untied him and asked Peng Qi and Ling Zhen, who had already submitted, to persuade him to join. His family was then brought from Chenzhou. At the great assembly he became a cavalry officer with long-range scouting duties.

At Changzhou during the Fang La campaign, Han pursued Jin Jie and was shot in the cheek by Gao Keli, falling from his horse. Before Qin Ming could rescue him, Zhang Jinren stabbed him in the throat and killed him. Peng Qi was then slain while trying to avenge him.
韩滔是东京人，武举出身，任陈州团练使，号「百胜将」，使枣木槊。他被呼延灼举荐为征.ja:
韓滔は東京の出身で武挙に及第し、陳州の団練使を務めた。「百勝将」と呼ばれ、棗の木の槊を使う。呼延灼から梁山泊征討の正先鋒に推薦され、副先鋒の彭玘とともに出陣した。

梁山軍が鉤鎌槍で連環馬を破ると、劉唐と杜遷に捕らえられる。宋江は縄を解き、すでに降っていた彭玘と凌振に説得させ、陳州から家族も迎えた。大聚義では遠方の偵察を兼ねる馬軍小彪将となった。

方臘征討の常州攻めでは金節を追う途中、高可立の矢を頬に受けて落馬した。秦明の救援が間に合う前に、張近仁に喉を突かれて殺される。彭玘も続いて仇を討とうとした戦いで命を落とした。

郝思文号「井木犴」，是关胜的结义兄弟。关胜介绍他时说，他母亲梦见井木犴投胎而有孕.en:
Hao Siwen, the Wooden Dog of the Well, was Guan Sheng's sworn brother. Introducing him, Guan said that Hao's mother had conceived after dreaming that the corresponding star spirit would be born through her, hence his nickname. Guan also praised his command of the eighteen martial skills.

When Xuan Zan recommended Guan Sheng to lead an expedition against Liangshan, Hao accompanied him. After Huyan Zhuo's false surrender led to Guan's capture, Lin Chong and Hua Rong attacked Hao together. As he retreated, Hu Sanniang pulled him from his horse with a lasso. He then submitted with Guan and Xuan. He was captured again during the Lingzhou expedition, but Li Kui, Jiao Ting, and Bao Xu rescued him from his prison cart.

After the great assembly Hao served as a cavalry scout commander. During the Fang La campaign, he and Xu Ning were ambushed while reconnoitering Hangzhou's northern gate. Hao was captured and put to death by dismemberment on Fang Tianding's orders, and his head was displayed on the wall. Xu Ning was struck by a poisoned arrow while trying to save him and died half a month later.
郝思文号「井木犴」，是关胜的结义兄弟。关胜介绍他时说，他母亲梦见井木犴投胎而有孕.ja:
郝思文は「井木犴」と呼ばれ、関勝の義兄弟だった。関勝の紹介によれば、母が井木犴の生まれ変わりを宿す夢を見て身ごもったことから、この名で呼ばれたという。関勝は十八般の武芸にも通じていると評している。

宣賛が関勝を梁山泊征討の将に推薦すると、郝思文も同行した。関勝が呼延灼の偽投降に誘われて捕まると、郝思文は林沖と花栄に攻められ、退くところを扈三娘の投げ縄で落馬させられた。関勝、宣賛とともに降り、後の凌州への出陣でも捕らわれたが、護送中に李逵、焦挺、鮑旭に救い出された。

大聚義後は馬軍の偵察頭領を務めた。方臘征討で徐寧と杭州の北関門を探った際、伏兵に捕らえられ、方天定によって凌遅刑に処され、首を城壁にさらされた。救おうとした徐寧も毒矢を受け、半月後に亡くなった。

侯健是洪都人，号「通臂猿」，身材黑瘦轻捷，裁缝手艺出众，也曾拜薛永为师学习枪棒。.en:
Hou Jian was a tailor from Hongdu, nicknamed the Long-Armed Ape. Dark, lean, and nimble, he was highly skilled with a needle and had also studied martial arts under Xue Yong. While making clothes at Huang Wenbing's house in Wuwei, he met his teacher, who was gathering intelligence, and was taken to Song Jiang.

Hou explained Huang's role in framing Song and described the approaches to his house, helping the men attack it for revenge. He subsequently joined Liangshan and took charge of making banners and military robes, retaining that responsibility at the great assembly.

During the Fang La campaign, he and Duan Jingzhu accompanied Zhang Heng and Ruan Xiaoqi to find boats on the coast. They intended to sail from Haiyan into the Qiantang River, but the wind drove them out to sea and wrecked their vessels as they tried to return. Hou and Duan could not swim and drowned. Zhang and Ruan swam to safety and later rejoined the army separately.
侯健是洪都人，号「通臂猿」，身材黑瘦轻捷，裁缝手艺出众，也曾拜薛永为师学习枪棒。.ja:
侯健は洪都の仕立職人で、「通臂猿」と呼ばれた。色黒で痩せ、身軽に動き、裁縫に優れる一方、薛永について槍や棒も学んでいた。無為軍の黄文炳の家で衣服を作っていた時、情報を探りに来た師と会い、宋江のもとへ案内される。

侯健は黄文炳が宋江を陥れた事情や屋敷への道を説明し、一行の黄家襲撃を助けた。その後は梁山泊に入り、旗や軍服の製作を受け持ち、大聚義でも引き続きその役に任じられた。

方臘征討では段景住とともに張横、阮小七に従って海辺で船を探し、海塩から銭塘江へ入る予定だった。しかし風で沖へ流され、引き返す際に船が壊れた。泳げない侯健と段景住は海で溺死する。張横と阮小七は泳いで逃れ、後に別々に軍へ戻った。

扈三娘号「一丈青」，是独龙冈扈家庄的女将，原与祝彪定亲，善使日月双刀。梁山攻祝家.en:
Hu Sanniang, known as Ten Feet of Green, was a warrior of the Hu estate on Dulong Ridge. Originally betrothed to Zhu Biao, she fought with paired Sun-and-Moon sabers. She joined the defense of the Zhu estate against Liangshan and captured Wang Ying. While pursuing Song Jiang, she was captured by Lin Chong and sent to Liangshan.

Her brother Hu Cheng later sought peace with Song Jiang, but after the Zhu estate fell, Li Kui killed the Hu household while Hu Cheng escaped. Song Jiang's father adopted Hu Sanniang, and Song arranged her marriage to Wang Ying. She subsequently often fought beside her husband and also captured opponents with a lasso.

During the assault on Muzhou in the Fang La campaign, the couple were sent to scout toward Qingxi and encountered Zheng Biao. His magic startled Wang Ying, who was struck down by a spear. Hu Sanniang went to help and then pursued Zheng. He turned and threw a gilded copper brick into her face, killing her as she fell from her horse. After the campaign she was posthumously named Lady of Huayang Commandery.
扈三娘号「一丈青」，是独龙冈扈家庄的女将，原与祝彪定亲，善使日月双刀。梁山攻祝家.ja:
扈三娘は「一丈青」と呼ばれる独竜岡の扈家荘の女将で、もとは祝彪の婚約者だった。日月双刀を使い、梁山軍の祝家荘攻めでは援軍として出陣し、王英を捕らえる。その後、宋江を追うところを林沖に捕らえられ、梁山泊へ送られた。

兄の扈成は宋江と和解を図ったが、祝家荘が敗れた後、李逵は扈太公の一家を殺し、扈成は逃れた。宋太公が扈三娘を養女に迎え、宋江が王英との結婚を取り決める。その後は夫と同じ陣で戦うことが多く、投げ縄で敵将を捕らえることもあった。

方臘征討の睦州攻めでは、夫妻で清渓方面を偵察するよう命じられ、鄭彪に遭遇した。王英は法術に驚いて槍で倒される。扈三娘は救援に出て鄭彪を追ったが、彼が振り向いて投げた金めっきの銅の塊を顔面に受け、落馬して亡くなった。帰還後、花陽郡夫人を追贈された。

呼延灼号「双鞭」，原任汝宁郡都统制，原著称他为呼延赞后裔。他奉命征梁山，荐韩滔、.en:
Huyan Zhuo, the Twin Rods, originally commanded troops in Runing. The novel identifies him as a descendant of Huyan Zan. Ordered to attack Liangshan, he recommended Han Tao and Peng Qi as his vanguard officers. Mounted on the emperor's gift, a black horse with white feet, he initially defeated Liangshan's forces with linked armored cavalry.

After Xu Ning taught the hooked-lance technique, the linked cavalry was broken. Huyan fled to Prefect Murong in Qingzhou and attacked the nearby mountain bands. The three bands summoned help from Liangshan, and Song Jiang lured Huyan into pursuit and captured him. After submitting, Huyan helped trick the defenders into opening Qingzhou's gates and joined the others at Liangshan. At the great assembly he became one of the Five Tiger Generals.

He served in the campaigns after the amnesty and was appointed commander of the imperial guard after Fang La's defeat, attending the emperor at military exercises. The novel adds that he later fought the Jin commander Wuzhu and was killed on campaign in Huaixi.
呼延灼号「双鞭」，原任汝宁郡都统制，原著称他为呼延赞后裔。他奉命征梁山，荐韩滔、.ja:
呼延灼は「双鞭」と呼ばれ、もとは汝寧郡の都統制で、原著では呼延賛の子孫とされる。梁山泊征討を命じられると、韓滔と彭玘を先鋒に推薦した。皇帝から賜った踢雪烏騅に乗り、連環馬によって一時は梁山軍を苦しめた。

徐寧が鉤鎌槍の技を伝えて連環馬が破られると、青州へ逃れて慕容知府を頼り、周辺の山寨を攻めた。三山の一党が梁山泊に救援を求めると、宋江の策で追撃へ誘い出され、捕らえられる。降った後は青州の城門を開かせるのを助け、一行と梁山泊へ向かった。大聚義では馬軍五虎将の一人となった。

招安後の征戦にも従い、方臘平定後は御営兵馬指揮使を授けられ、皇帝に随行して軍備を整えた。原著はさらに、後に金の兀朮と戦い、淮西へ出陣して戦死したと記している。

花荣号「小李广」，是清风寨武知寨，善枪，更以射箭闻名。宋江逃罪来投，因刘高妻子诬.en:
Hua Rong, Little Li Guang, was the military commandant of Qingfeng Stockade. Skilled with a spear, he was especially renowned for archery. Song Jiang sought refuge with him while fleeing prosecution. After Liu Gao's wife falsely accused Song and had him arrested, Hua forcibly rescued him, but was later trapped at a banquet arranged by Huang Xin. The Qingfeng Mountain band raided the prison carts and rescued both men, bringing Hua into their company.

After Qin Ming and Huang Xin also joined, the group headed for Liangshan. At Duiying Mountain, Hua separated the tangled halberds of Lu Fang and Guo Sheng with one arrow. Soon after reaching Liangshan, he declared that he would hit the third goose in a flight and did so, convincing Chao Gai and the others of his skill. At the great assembly he joined the Eight Cavalry Commanders and Vanguard Officers.

After the Fang La campaign Hua was appointed commander of troops at Yingtian. Following Song Jiang's death, he dreamed that Song and Li Kui came to bid him farewell. He hurried to the grave at Liao'er Marsh in Chuzhou and met Wu Yong, who had received the same dream. After weeping together, the two hanged themselves beside the grave and were buried next to Song Jiang.
花荣号「小李广」，是清风寨武知寨，善枪，更以射箭闻名。宋江逃罪来投，因刘高妻子诬.ja:
花栄は「小李広」と呼ばれる清風寨の武知寨で、槍に優れ、とりわけ弓の名手として知られた。罪から逃れて来た宋江が劉高の妻の讒言で捕らえられると、強引に救い出す。しかし花栄自身も黄信の宴席の罠にかかり、清風山の一党が囚人車を襲って二人を救ったことで、彼らと行動をともにするようになった。

秦明と黄信も加わると、一行は梁山泊へ向かう。対影山では、絡み合った呂方と郭盛の戟を一矢で分けた。梁山泊に着いて間もなく、飛ぶ雁の三羽目を狙うと宣言して的中させ、晁蓋たちを感服させる。大聚義では馬軍八虎騎兼先鋒使に列せられた。

方臘征討後は応天府兵馬都統制となった。宋江が死ぬと、宋江と李逵が別れを告げに来る夢を見て、楚州の蓼児窪へ急ぎ、同じ夢に導かれた呉用と墓前で出会う。二人はともに泣いた後、墓のそばで首をつり、宋江の墓の隣に葬られた。

黄信原是青州兵马都监，使用丧门剑，因自夸要捉尽清风山、二龙山、桃花山三处强人，号.en:
Huang Xin was the military commander at Qingzhou and wielded a sword called the Death Gate. His boast that he would capture every outlaw on Qingfeng, Twin Dragons, and Peach Blossom mountains earned him the name Suppressor of Three Mountains. He had learned martial arts from Qin Ming.

After Liu Gao accused Song Jiang and Hua Rong, Huang was sent to Qingfeng Stockade. He lured Hua into a banquet trap and escorted the two prisoners toward Qingzhou, with Liu Gao accompanying them. Yan Shun, Wang Ying, and Zheng Tianshou attacked the prison carts on the road. Unable to withstand them, Huang withdrew to defend Qingfeng Stockade. After joining Song Jiang, Qin Ming came to persuade him, and he opened the gates and joined the group on its eventual journey to Liangshan.

At the great assembly Huang became a cavalry officer with long-range scouting duties and continued to serve after the amnesty. He survived the Fang La campaign and returned to duty at Qingzhou after receiving his reward. The novel does not describe his later lifespan or death.
黄信原是青州兵马都监，使用丧门剑，因自夸要捉尽清风山、二龙山、桃花山三处强人，号.ja:
黄信はもと青州の兵馬都監で、喪門剣を使った。清風山、二竜山、桃花山の山賊をすべて捕らえると豪語し、「鎮三山」と呼ばれた。武芸は秦明に学んでいる。

劉高が宋江と花栄を訴えると、黄信は清風寨へ派遣され、宴席に誘って花栄を捕らえた。劉高も同行し、二人を青州へ護送する途中、燕順、王英、鄭天寿に囚人車を襲われる。敵わず清風寨へ退いて守りを固めたが、宋江の仲間となった秦明が説得に来ると寨門を開き、後に一行と梁山泊へ向かった。

大聚義では遠方の偵察を兼ねる馬軍小彪将となり、招安後も従軍した。方臘征討を生き延びて恩賞を受けると、再び青州で用いられた。その後の寿命や死去の事情は原著に記されていない。

皇甫端是幽州人，在东昌府行兽医之业，碧眼黄须，号「紫髯伯」。他善于相马、辨认牲畜.en:
Huangfu Duan was a veterinarian from Youzhou working in Dongchang. With blue-green eyes and a yellow beard, he was known as Purple Beard. He could judge horses, diagnose animal illnesses, and treat them with needles and medicine. After submitting to Liangshan, Zhang Qing recommended him to Song Jiang. Huangfu brought his family to the stronghold and became the last hero to join.

At the great assembly Huangfu was assigned to treat the army's horses. He accompanied the campaigns following the amnesty, but after Wang Qing's defeat, just before the expedition against Fang La, the emperor retained him and Jin Dajian for service at court. He therefore did not take part in the southern campaign.

At the end of the novel he is serving as chief administrator of the Imperial Stables. His death is not described.
皇甫端是幽州人，在东昌府行兽医之业，碧眼黄须，号「紫髯伯」。他善于相马、辨认牲畜.ja:
皇甫端は幽州の出身で、東昌府で獣医を営み、碧眼と黄色い髭を持ち、「紫髯伯」と呼ばれた。馬を見分け、家畜の病を診断して針や薬で治療した。張清が梁山泊へ降った後、宋江に推薦され、家族を連れて山寨に入り、最後に加わった好漢となった。

大聚義では軍馬の治療を担当した。招安後の征戦にも同行したが、王慶平定後、方臘征討へ出発する直前に、皇帝が金大堅とともに手元へ留めて用いることにしたため、江南での征討には参加していない。

物語の末尾では御馬監の大使を務めている。死去の事情は書かれていない。

蒋敬是湖南潭州人，原是落第举子，后来弃文习武，精通书算，也能使枪棒、排兵布阵，号.en:
Jiang Jing came from Tanzhou in Hunan. After failing the civil examinations, he turned to martial studies. Skilled in accounting, he could also use spear and staff and arrange troops in battle. Known as the Divine Calculator, he formed a band on Huangmen Mountain with Ou Peng, Ma Lin, and Tao Zongwang.

When Song Jiang, Chao Gai, and their companions passed the mountain on their return from the rescue at Jiangzhou, the four leaders welcomed them with a feast. Song invited them to Liangshan, and Jiang and the others gladly agreed, gathering their men and belongings for the journey. At the great assembly Jiang was assigned to audit receipts and expenditures of money and provisions.

He campaigned with the army after the amnesty. At Hangzhou during the Fang La campaign, he also recorded the officers' achievements with Pei Xuan. After returning and receiving his reward, he went home to Tanzhou as a commoner because he missed his native place. The novel does not say that he later became a wealthy landowner or describe his death.
蒋敬是湖南潭州人，原是落第举子，后来弃文习武，精通书算，也能使枪棒、排兵布阵，号.ja:
蔣敬は湖南潭州の出身で、科挙に落第した後、学問から武芸へ転じた。書算に優れるほか、槍や棒を使い、陣を布くこともでき、「神算子」と呼ばれた。欧鵬、馬麟、陶宗旺とともに黄門山で一党を率いていた。

江州での救出を終えた宋江、晁蓋たちが梁山泊へ戻る途中で黄門山を通ると、四人は一行を山へ迎えて宴を開いた。宋江から梁山泊へ誘われ、蔣敬たちは喜んで応じ、人馬や財物を整えて同行する。大聚義では金銭と兵糧の出納計算を担当した。

招安後も従軍し、方臘征討で杭州に至った時には裴宣とともに諸将の功績を記録した。帰還して恩賞を受けると、故郷を思って潭州へ戻り、平民となった。その後に富豪となったことや死去の事情は原著に記されていない。

焦挺是中山府人，家传三代以相扑为生，号「没面目」。他自述投奔他人总不得门路，原想.en:
Jiao Ting came from Zhongshan, where his family had practiced wrestling for three generations. Known as the Faceless One, he said that he had never been able to find anyone to take him in. He intended to join Bao Xu on Kushu Mountain when he encountered Li Kui, who had left Liangshan without permission.

Li Kui quarreled with him and was knocked down repeatedly, but the two became companions after exchanging names. They went to Bao Xu, and the three seized a prison cart convoy, rescuing Xuan Zan and Hao Siwen. They then helped attack Lingzhou and joined Liangshan together. At the great assembly Jiao became an infantry officer.

He served in the campaigns after the amnesty. Just after the capture of Runzhou in the Fang La campaign, Song Jiang mustered his officers and found that Jiao Ting, Song Wan, and Tao Zongwang had died amid arrows and trampling horses in the fighting. They were the first Liangshan leaders lost in this southern campaign.
焦挺是中山府人，家传三代以相扑为生，号「没面目」。他自述投奔他人总不得门路，原想.ja:
焦挺は中山府の出身で、三代にわたり相撲で暮らす家に生まれ、「没面目」と呼ばれた。人を頼ろうとしても受け入れられず、枯樹山の鮑旭の仲間になろうと向かう途中、梁山泊を勝手に下りた李逵と出会う。

争いを起こした李逵を続けて倒したが、名を明かし合うと仲間になった。二人で鮑旭を訪れ、三人で囚人車を奪って宣賛と郝思文を救い、その後は凌州攻めを助けて梁山泊へ入る。大聚義では歩軍将校となった。

招安後も従軍した。方臘征討で潤州を落とした直後、宋江が諸将を点呼すると、焦挺、宋万、陶宗旺の三人は矢が飛び交い馬が踏み荒らす乱戦の中ですでに死んでいた。江南でのこの戦いで、最初に失われた梁山の頭領たちである。

金大坚住在济州，号「玉臂匠」，擅长刻碑、雕玉和镌印，也会枪棒。他是吴用的旧识。宋.en:
Jin Dajian lived in Jizhou and was known as the Jade-Armed Craftsman. He excelled at carving inscriptions, jade, and seals, and also practiced martial arts. An old acquaintance of Wu Yong, he was needed when Song Jiang faced execution in Jiangzhou. Wu planned to forge a letter from Cai Jing and sent Dai Zong to invite Jin and Xiao Rang to work on a monument at the temple of Mount Tai, arranging for them to be intercepted and taken to Liangshan.

Their families were also brought to the mountain by deception. Jin stayed and helped Xiao produce the forged letter and seal. Huang Wenbing later exposed the forgery because it used Cai Jing's old Hanlin seal and a personal-name seal inappropriate for a father's letter to his son. At the great assembly Jin was put in charge of military tallies and seals.

After Wang Qing's defeat, the emperor ordered the campaign against Fang La but retained Jin and Huangfu Duan at court. At the end of the novel Jin holds office in the Imperial Seal Bureau. His death is not described.
金大坚住在济州，号「玉臂匠」，擅长刻碑、雕玉和镌印，也会枪棒。他是吴用的旧识。宋.ja:
金大堅は済州に住み、「玉臂匠」と呼ばれ、碑文、玉、印章の彫刻に優れ、槍や棒も使えた。呉用の旧知であり、宋江が江州で危機に陥ると、蔡京の手紙を偽造しようとする呉用に求められる。戴宗が泰安の岳廟の碑を刻む仕事と偽って金大堅と蕭譲を誘い、途中で梁山の手勢が二人を山寨へ連れていった。

家族も計略で山へ運ばれたため、金大堅は残り、蕭譲と偽の手紙と印を作った。しかし蔡京が翰林学士だった頃の印を使い、父から子への手紙に名を刻んだ印を押した不自然さを、黄文炳に見抜かれる。大聚義では兵符と印章の製作を担当した。

王慶平定後、皇帝は方臘征討を命じる一方、金大堅と皇甫端を都に留めた。物語の末尾では内府御宝監の官を務めており、死去の事情は記されていない。

孔亮号「独火星」，与兄长孔明住在白虎山下孔家庄，曾拜宋江为师学习枪棒。武松路过村.en:
Kong Liang, the Lone Fire Star, lived with his elder brother Kong Ming at their family estate below White Tiger Mountain. They had studied martial arts under Song Jiang. When Wu Song passed through a village inn, he quarreled with Kong Liang and injured him. Wu was later caught after falling down drunk, but Song Jiang, then staying at the estate, identified him and reconciled the two sides.

After killing a local enemy's household, the brothers gathered men on White Tiger Mountain. They attacked Qingzhou to rescue their imprisoned uncle Kong Bin, but Huyan Zhuo captured Kong Ming. Kong Liang escaped, appealed to the Twin Dragons band, and personally traveled to Liangshan to request Song Jiang's help. After the three mountain bands captured Qingzhou, both brothers joined Liangshan. At the great assembly they became infantry guards of the central command.

During the Fang La campaign, Kong Liang accompanied the river forces in the attack on Kunshan. Unable to swim, he fell into the water and drowned. Kong Ming later fell ill at Hangzhou and likewise did not survive.
孔亮号「独火星」，与兄长孔明住在白虎山下孔家庄，曾拜宋江为师学习枪棒。武松路过村.ja:
孔亮は「独火星」と呼ばれ、兄の孔明と白虎山の麓の孔家荘に住み、宋江に槍棒を学んだ。村の酒店を通った武松と争って打ち傷を負う。武松も後に酔いつぶれて孔家に捕らえられたが、滞在していた宋江が素性を説明し、双方を仲直りさせた。

兄弟は地元の仇敵の一家を殺した後、白虎山で一党を率いた。叔父の孔賓が青州に投獄されると救出に向かうが、孔明が呼延灼に捕らえられる。逃れた孔亮は二竜山へ助けを求め、さらに自ら梁山泊へ赴いて宋江に出兵を頼んだ。三山の一党が青州を落とした後、兄弟は梁山泊へ加わり、大聚義では中軍を守る歩軍の将となった。

方臘征討では水軍の昆山攻めに従ったが、泳げず、落水して溺死した。後に杭州で病んだ孔明も生還できなかった。

孔明号「毛头星」，是孔亮的兄长，住在白虎山下孔家庄。宋江逃罪时曾在庄上居住，兄弟.en:
Kong Ming, the Shaggy Star, was Kong Liang's elder brother and lived at the Kong estate below White Tiger Mountain. Song Jiang stayed there while fleeing prosecution, and the brothers studied martial arts under him. Through Song's mediation they also became acquainted with Wu Song, who had injured Kong Liang.

After killing an enemy's household, the brothers occupied White Tiger Mountain. They attacked Qingzhou to rescue their uncle Kong Bin from official custody. Kong Ming fought Huyan Zhuo for more than twenty exchanges before being captured from horseback. Kong Liang appealed first to the Twin Dragons band and then to Liangshan. After Qingzhou fell, Kong Ming was freed and joined Liangshan with his brother.

At the great assembly the brothers became infantry guards of the central command. After Hangzhou was captured in the Fang La campaign, an epidemic spread through the city. Kong Ming fell ill along with Zhang Heng, Mu Hong, and others. Left behind to be cared for, he could not continue the expedition and eventually died of illness.
孔明号「毛头星」，是孔亮的兄长，住在白虎山下孔家庄。宋江逃罪时曾在庄上居住，兄弟.ja:
孔明は「毛頭星」と呼ばれる孔亮の兄で、白虎山の麓の孔家荘に住んでいた。罪から逃れる宋江が庄に滞在した時、兄弟で槍棒を学んだ。孔亮を打ち傷つけた武松とも、宋江の仲立ちで知り合う。

仇敵の一家を殺した兄弟は白虎山を占拠した。青州に捕らわれた叔父の孔賓を救おうと城を攻めたが、孔明は呼延灼と二十合余り戦って馬上から生け捕られた。孔亮が二竜山、次いで梁山泊に援軍を求め、青州が落ちると孔明は救われ、弟と梁山泊へ向かった。

大聚義では兄弟で中軍を守る歩軍の将となった。方臘征討で杭州を落とした後、町に疫病が広まり、孔明は張横、穆弘らとともに病に倒れる。看病のため残されて進軍できず、ついに病死した。

雷横是郓城县步兵都头，打铁匠出身，后来开碓房、杀牛、设赌，因能跳过宽涧，号「插翅.en:
Lei Heng was an infantry constable in Yuncheng. Originally a blacksmith, he later ran a grain mill, slaughtered cattle, and operated gambling tables. His ability to leap wide ravines earned him the name Winged Tiger. On a night patrol he arrested Liu Tang, who was sleeping drunk in a temple; Chao Gai secured Liu's release by claiming he was his nephew.

When Lei attended a performance by Bai Xiuying and her father, he forgot his reward money, quarreled with Bai Yuqiao, and injured him. He was punished with public exposure in a cangue. Bai Xiuying then beat Lei's mother when she came to bring food, and Lei killed the performer with his cangue. Zhu Tong was ordered to escort him but secretly let him return home and flee with his mother. Lei joined Liangshan and later helped its leaders coerce Zhu Tong into joining as well.

At the great assembly Lei became an infantry commander. During the Fang La campaign, he fought Si Xingfang outside Deqing's southern gate for thirty exchanges before being cut from his horse and killed.
雷横是郓城县步兵都头，打铁匠出身，后来开碓房、杀牛、设赌，因能跳过宽涧，号「插翅.ja:
雷横は鄆城県の歩兵都頭で、鍛冶屋に生まれ、その後は精穀場や牛の屠畜、賭場を営んだ。広い谷を跳び越える力から「挿翅虎」と呼ばれた。夜回りで霊官廟に酔って寝ていた劉唐を捕らえたが、晁蓋が甥だと偽って釈放させた。

白秀英父娘の芸を見に行って祝儀の金を忘れ、父の白玉喬と争って傷つけたため、首枷をつけてさらされた。食事を届けに来た母が白秀英に殴られると、雷横は枷を振り上げて白秀英を殺す。護送を命じられた朱仝がひそかに逃がしたので、母を連れて梁山泊へ入った。後には梁山側が朱仝を仲間に引き入れるための強引な計画にも加わった。

大聚義では歩軍頭領となる。方臘征討の徳清県攻めで、南門外にて司行方と三十合戦い、馬上から斬り落とされて死んだ。

李衮是邳县人，号「飞天大圣」，与樊瑞、项充在芒砀山聚众。他左手执团牌，右手使剑，.en:
Li Gun came from Pixian and was known as the Flying Great Sage. He led a band on Mangdang Mountain with Fan Rui and Xiang Chong. He carried a round shield in his left hand, a sword in his right, and twenty-four throwing javelins on his back, specializing in close fighting and thrown weapons.

During the conflict with Liangshan, Li and Xiang first defeated Shi Jin's force, but later entered Gongsun Sheng's formation and were captured in a pit. Song Jiang released them, and they returned to persuade Fan Rui to surrender. All three brought their followers to Liangshan. After the great assembly Li served as an infantry officer, often protecting Li Kui alongside Xiang Chong during charges.

At Muzhou in the Fang La campaign, the three pursued Zheng Biao across unfamiliar mountain terrain and were intercepted after crossing a stream. Li Gun fell into deep water and was killed by a volley of arrows. Xiang Chong was tripped by a rope and killed while trying to withdraw; only Li Kui was rescued.
李衮是邳县人，号「飞天大圣」，与樊瑞、项充在芒砀山聚众。他左手执团牌，右手使剑，.ja:
李袞は邳県の出身で、「飛天大聖」と呼ばれ、樊瑞、項充と芒碭山で一党を率いた。左手に丸盾、右手に剣を持ち、背に二十四本の投げ槍を差し、歩戦と投擲を得意とした。

梁山軍との戦いでは項充とまず史進らを退けたが、後に公孫勝の陣へ入って落とし穴にかかり、捕らえられた。宋江に放されると山へ戻って樊瑞を説き、三人で一党を率いて梁山泊へ入る。大聚義後は歩軍将校となり、項充とともに李逵を守って敵陣へ突入した。

方臘征討の睦州攻めでは三人で鄭彪を追い、土地勘のない山道を進んで、小川を渡った先で敵兵に阻まれた。李袞は深い流れに転び落ち、矢を浴びて殺される。項充も退こうとして縄に足を取られ殺され、李逵だけが救い出された。
